spec.description: The hourly forecast for one grid cell: one period per hour for about the next week, carrying dew point and relative humidity the twice-daily forecast leaves out, and no prose.

request.title: GetHourlyForecastRequest
request.description: Which grid cell, and in which units.

office.description: Three-letter forecast office code addressing the grid, such as `SEW`. `points.get_point` returns it as `gridId`.

units.description: Unit system for the rendered temperatures: `us` for Fahrenheit and miles per hour, `si` for Celsius and kilometres per hour. Defaults to `us`.

response.title: HourlyForecastFeature
response.description: The hourly forecast, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in.

geometry.description: Outline of the grid cell the forecast covers.

properties.description: The forecast itself, one period per hour.

notes: Same shape as the twice-daily forecast, so it shares `Forecast`: the hourly periods leave `name` and `detailedForecast` empty and fill `dewpoint` and `relativeHumidity`, all of which that schema already allows.
